mod.name: Random Combat Events
settings.main.description: At combat start, a fixed seed plans checkpoints for the first 100 turns. Reloading will not reroll them.
settings.preset.casual.description: Checks every 5–7 turns, schedules an event 35% of the time, and warns 2 turns ahead.
settings.preset.standard.description: Checks every 3–5 turns, schedules an event 50% of the time, and warns 1 turn ahead.
settings.preset.chaos.description: Checks every 1–3 turns and schedules an event 80% of the time.
settings.incident_chance.description: In Standard mode, an empty checkpoint still rolls the next 3–5 turn gap, so events may occur on turns 3, 11, and 15.
settings.combat.boss.description: Enabled by default in this version. If a specific Boss conflicts, only that combination will be disabled later.
settings.toxic_fog.description: During a Toxic Fog turn, each attack hit that is not fully Blocked triggers this once.
settings.gentle_rain.player_minimum.desc: The least a player heals for, whatever the percentage comes to. Enemies keep a minimum of 1, so without this the rain pays the fuller enemy side more than it pays you.
incident.warning.rockfall: In {0}, falling rocks will deal {1} damage to every unit at the end of the player side's turn.
incident.warning.sword_rain: In {0}, Sword Rain will strike every unit on each side at the end of that side's turn for {1} damage × {2}.
incident.warning.toxic_fog: In {0}, Toxic Fog will cover the battlefield for that turn. After taking unblocked attack damage, a unit gains {1} {2}.
incident.warning.vine_snare: In {0}, vines will apply {1} {2} to all players and enemies.
incident.warning.damp_sea_wind: In {0}, Damp Sea Wind will apply {1} {2} and {3} {4} to all players and enemies.
incident.warning.hive_onslaught: In {0}, Hive Onslaught will begin. For {1}, both sides take {2} damage at the end of their own side's turn.
incident.warning.gentle_rain: In {0}, Gentle Rain will heal every living unit for {1}% of its own max HP. Players heal at least {2}; anything else heals at least 1.
incident.warning.default: A combat event will occur in {0}.
incident.trigger.rockfall: The boulders are coming loose! At the end of this turn, every unit will take {0} damage.
incident.trigger.sword_rain: Blades fill the sky! Each side will take {0} damage × {1} at the end of its own turn.
incident.trigger.toxic_fog: Toxic Fog covers the battlefield! This turn, after taking unblocked attack damage, a unit gains {0} {1}.
incident.trigger.vine_snare: Vines bind both sides! All players and enemies gain {0} {1}.
incident.trigger.damp_sea_wind: Damp Sea Wind erodes the battlefield! All players and enemies gain {0} {1} and {2} {3}.
incident.trigger.gentle_rain: Gentle Rain soaks the battlefield! Every living unit heals {0}% of its own max HP. Players heal at least {1}; anything else heals at least 1.
incident.hive.wave: Hive wave {0}/{1} approaches! Both sides will take {2} damage at the end of their own side's turn.
incident.result.players: {0} lands on your side: {1} lost {2} HP in total.
incident.result.players_blocked: {0} lands on your side: {1} lost {2} HP in total, and {3} more was blocked.
incident.result.enemies: {0} lands on the enemy side: {1} lost {2} HP in total.
incident.result.enemies_blocked: {0} lands on the enemy side: {1} lost {2} HP in total, and {3} more was blocked.
incident.result.everyone: {0} lands on the whole room: {1} lost {2} HP in total.
incident.result.everyone_blocked: {0} lands on the whole room: {1} lost {2} HP in total, and {3} more was blocked.
boon.blessing.card: Neow smiles on you! {0} is added to your hand.
boon.blessing.power: Neow smiles on you! You gain {0} {1}.
boon.curse.card: The Architect meddles! {0} is shuffled into your {1}.
incident.warning.neows_blessing: In {0}, Neow's Blessing will grant you a gift.
incident.warning.architects_curse: In {0}, the Architect's Curse will burden you.
settings.combat_start.description: Rolled once when combat begins, separately from the turn route. The remainder of the two chances is no effect.
miracle.granted: A Last Miracle watches over {0}. The first lethal blow it takes this combat leaves it at 1 HP instead.
miracle.trigger: Last Miracle! {0} holds on at 1 HP. The charge is spent, so the next lethal blow lands.
settings.miracle.description: Rolled per unit when combat begins and announced on screen while it lasts. A unit holding one survives its first lethal blow at 1 HP; later hits of the same attack still land.
incident.warning.laser: In {0}, a laser will sweep the field. Every unit takes {1}% of its own max HP at the end of its own side's turn, and you will take {2}. Block can prevent it.
incident.trigger.laser: A laser sweeps the field! Every unit takes {0}% of its own max HP at the end of its own side's turn, and you will take {1}. Block can prevent it.
settings.laser.description: Charged against each unit's own max HP, so it costs a Boss far more than it costs you, and it resolves at the end of each side's own turn where Block still works.
settings.preset.hell.description: Checks every 2–4 turns, schedules an event 75% of the time, opens every fight on the Architect's Curse, and cuts the helpful events down to almost nothing. The other three modes can only ever open on a gift.
summon.free.ally: {0} wanders in and takes your side.
summon.free.enemy: {0} wanders in and sides against you.
summon.mercenary.offer: {0} offers to fight for you, for {1} gold. It wants paying next turn.
summon.mercenary.too_expensive: {0} sizes up your purse, quotes {1} gold, and moves on when it sees you cannot cover it.
summon.mercenary.declined: You wave {0} off. It shrugs and leaves.
summon.mercenary.accepted: You shake on it with {0}. {1} gold changes hands next turn.
summon.mercenary.helps: You pay {1} gold and {0} joins your side.
summon.mercenary.ran_off: You pay {1} gold and {0} is already gone. Nothing you can do about it.
summon.mercenary.betrayed: You pay {1} gold and {0} decides anyone carrying that much is worth robbing. It joins the enemy.
summon.recruit.offer: {0} is about to join the enemy. Gold can talk it down for {1}, or bring it over for {2}.
summon.recruit.follow_up: How much is {0} worth to you? Standing down costs {1}. Fighting for you costs {2}.
summon.recruit.stood_down: {1} gold, and {0} stays out of it.
summon.recruit.ran_off: {1} gold, and {0} takes it and vanishes.
summon.recruit.helps: {1} gold, and {0} turns around to fight for you.
summon.recruit.paid_joined: {1} gold gone, and {0} joins the enemy side anyway.
summon.challenge.offer_elite: {0} wants in on this fight. It looks like it can take one. Beating it pays.
summon.challenge.offer: {0} wants in on this fight. Beating it pays.
summon.challenge.accepted: You wave {0} in. It joins the enemy side.
summon.challenge.fled: You wave {0} in and it thinks better of it, dropping what it was carrying as it goes.
summon.challenge.left: You turn {0} away. It says its piece and goes.
summon.challenge.forced: You turn {0} away. It joins anyway.
settings.free_summon.description: A small monster wanders in and picks a side. No choice and no cost, so it is always drawn from the weakest tier.
settings.mercenary.description: A monster offers to fight for you. The gold is taken on the following turn, and it is taken whether or not the monster keeps its word.
settings.mercenary.run_off: Chance It Takes the Gold and Runs
settings.enemy_recruit.description: A monster is about to join the enemy. Gold can talk it down, or cost more and bring it over to you.
settings.challenge.description: Something asks to join the fight against you. Free to refuse, and worth extra spoils if you take it on.
settings.summons.extra_gold.description: Built to the same recipe the game uses for a room: gold, a card to choose from, a potion on a roll, and a relic for anything Elite-sized.
incident.warning.free_summon: In {0}, another monster will wander into the fight and pick a side.
incident.warning.mercenary: In {0}, a monster will offer to fight for you for gold.
incident.warning.enemy_recruit: In {0}, a monster will move to join the enemy, and gold will be able to change its mind.
incident.warning.challenge: In {0}, something will ask to join the fight against you, for extra spoils.
summon.left.ally: {0} loses interest and wanders off. You are on your own again.
summon.left.hired: {0} decides it has done enough and walks off. What you paid stays paid.
settings.summons.departure: Chance a Summon Leaves Each Turn
settings.summons.departure.description: Rolled every turn for each summoned monster, on either side. Nothing that wandered into a fight has a reason to see it through, so they do not have to be killed to be rid of.
settings.summons.relic: Chance of a Relic from an Ordinary Monster
settings.summons.relic.description: An added Elite always leaves a relic, the same way an Elite room always does. This is the chance an ordinary monster does too.
incident.warning.vakuu: In {0}, Vakuu will offer to take the turn after that off your hands.
incident.warning.darv: In {0}, Darv will offer a full hand in exchange for knowing what anything costs.
incident.warning.nonupeipe: In {0}, Nonupeipe will leave you a gift.
incident.warning.tanx: In {0}, Tanx will throw you a weapon for that turn.
incident.warning.tezcatara: In {0}, Tezcatara will lend you a relic cast in wax, good until this fight ends.
incident.warning.pael: In {0}, Pael will promise you energy and a card for the turn after that.
incident.warning.orobas: In {0}, Orobas will offer you a card from outside your own discipline.
ancient.vakuu.offer: Vakuu reaches for your hands. Let go, and next turn it plays every card you are holding — in the order it finds them, at whatever it feels like — and burns each one afterwards, playable or not.
ancient.vakuu.accepted: You let go. Next turn is Vakuu's.
ancient.vakuu.declined: You keep hold of your hand. Vakuu withdraws.
ancient.vakuu.trigger: Vakuu plays your hand and burns what it touched.
ancient.darv.offer: Darv offers to fill your hand next turn. The price is that every card you draw after that costs whatever it pleases, for the rest of this fight.
ancient.darv.accepted: Darv shakes on it. Your hand fills next turn.
ancient.darv.declined: You turn Darv down. It shrugs and drifts off.
ancient.darv.trigger: Darv fills your hand, and the prices come loose. Every card drawn from here costs what it likes.
ancient.nonupeipe.max_hp: Nonupeipe leaves you something warm. Everyone gains {0} max HP.
ancient.nonupeipe.gold: Nonupeipe promises everyone {0} once this fight is won. She is good for it.
ancient.nonupeipe.marked_room: Nonupeipe marks a fight further up the map. Something there will be waiting on its last point of health.
ancient.nonupeipe.no_room: Nonupeipe looks up the map for somewhere to leave her mark, and finds nothing ahead of you worth marking.
ancient.nonupeipe.marked_trigger: Nonupeipe got here first. {0} is down to 1 HP before you have thrown anything.
ancient.tanx.weapon: Tanx throws you {0}. Free this turn, and gone at the end of it.
ancient.tezcatara.ember: Tezcatara presses {0} into your hands, still soft. It works until this fight ends, and then it does not.
ancient.pael.promise: Pael promises you {0} energy and {1} card(s), next turn.
ancient.pael.trigger: Pael keeps its word: {0} energy and {1} card(s).
ancient.orobas.gift: Orobas hands over {0} from another discipline entirely. Free this turn, and gone at the end of it.
coop.vines.caught: {1} has {0} by the arms — they cannot play a card until it is cut down, and it will only take one hit. Potions still work, and the vines lose interest after {2}.
coop.vines.cut: The vines come apart. {0} has their hands back.
coop.vines.withered: The vines lose their grip on their own. {0} is free.
settings.vakuu.description: Asks first. Accept and Vakuu plays your whole hand next turn, in the order it sits, at whatever it happens to be aimed at — then burns every card it touched, playable or not.
settings.darv.description: Asks first. Accept and next turn opens on a full hand, with Confused for the rest of the fight: every card you draw from then on costs whatever it feels like.
settings.nonupeipe.description: One of three gifts, drawn on the weights below: max HP now, gold once the fight is won, or a room marked on the map where one enemy will be waiting at 1 HP.
settings.nonupeipe.marked.description: The mark lives on the map for this session only. Quitting to the menu and loading the run back in clears it.
settings.tanx.description: A random attack from your own discipline, free this turn and gone at the end of it.
settings.tezcatara.description: A relic cast in wax. It works for the rest of this fight and melts when the fight ends, the same way the Toy Box's do — it stays in your collection, spent.
settings.pael.description: Extra energy and an extra card, paid out next turn.
settings.orobas.description: Cards from every discipline but your own. Pick one; it is free this turn and gone at the end of it.
settings.strangling_vines.description: Co-op only. One player opens the fight held by vines and cannot play cards; anyone else can cut them down with a single attack. Potions still work, and the vines let go on their own eventually so a table can never be stuck.
settings.multiplayer.price_divisor.descr: What each player pays when the table buys something. Applied whatever the party size, so a full table is not the only one that can afford to say yes. Single-player runs always pay the full price.
